_about: Round 1331: the sourcing ledger behind src/lib/clubManagerSubsRule.ts. Every law line and every league row names two sources on two different hosts, none of them a wiki, each with the date it was read and the line quoted. scripts/simCmSubs.mjs section 1 holds the module's table to this file. Read by the Round 1331 builder on 2026-10-13.

laws.line: Before the May 2020 temporary amendment a top division club side could use at most three substitutes, with no limit on when.

sources.quote: Law 3, current wording: the 1st teams of clubs in the top division or senior 'A' international teams, where the maximum is three substitutes.
Barcelona won 17 points in 2018-19 when only three substitutions were possible.

laws.line: From May 2020 a competition could allow five substitutes in at most three opportunities during play, with changes at half time on top; unused changes carry into extra time.

sources.quote: Each team will be permitted to use a maximum of five substitutes. ... each team will only have three opportunities to make substitutions; substitutions may also be made at half-time.
Football's lawmakers have approved a temporary rule change that will allow each side up to five substitutions a match.
Unused substitutions and opportunities are carried forward into extra time.

laws.note: Round 1331 review (READ lens, minor 4): neither of the first two quotes says the carry into extra time; IFAB circular 20 does (read through pypdf on 2026-10-14), and Law 3 as it stands says the same (see breaksAreFree).

laws.line: Under Law 3 as it stands (five substitutes for good from 2022-23), a change at half time, between full time and extra time, or at half time in extra time does not use one of the three opportunities. Under the 2020 temporary amendment only half time was free, unless a competition allowed an extra change in extra time.

sources.quote: Substitutions may also be made in the period between full-time and the start of extra time, and at half-time in extra time ... these do not count as used substitution opportunities

making substitutions at half-time does not count as using one of the three opportunities ... Where competition rules allow an additional substitution in extra time, teams will each have one additional substitution opportunity; substitutions may also be made before the start of extra time and at half-time in extra time.

Where competition rules allow an additional substitution in extra time, teams will each have one additional substitution opportunity; substitutions may also be made before the start of extra time and at half-time in extra time.

laws.note: Round 1331 review (READ lens, minor 4): the fifa.com 2020 line frees the extra time breaks only under the extra change option, so it was quoted out of context; it is quoted whole now and Law 3 as it stands carries the unconditional line. The theifab.com page is /laws/latest/ (its season menu lists 2026/27 first and it shows no publication date; 2026-07-01 is that edition's start). The engine frees half time and the break before extra time in every five change season, 2020-21 and 2021-22 included, and has no extra time half time moment (clubManagerSubsRule.ts, SubsRule.stops).

laws.line: From 1 July 2022 the five substitute option is part of the Laws of the Game for good, still three opportunities plus half time.

facts.note: Round 1331 closing check (READ MAJOR 10): the Sky Sports report is of the Sky Bet Championship game Cardiff City 5-1 Watford and quotes Watford's head coach; ESPN's commentary of the same English League Championship game lists five changes for each side, each side's five in three stoppages (Watford at 56, 56, 56, 67 and 69; Cardiff City at 29, 69, 69, 82 and 82). Both pages were fetched whole on 2026-10-14 and the quoted lines found in them.

corroboration.quote: Championship clubs have opted to use five substitutes from nine named

rows.caveat: Five changes are sourced for 2026-27 itself by the second fact (two hosts, a league match of that season). No dated 2026-27 statement of the three opportunity limit was found: it is the EFL's rule from 2022-23 (the first fact), Law 3 as it stands mandates it only for top divisions (so in the Championship it is the competition's own rule), both sides in the 2026-27 match above used exactly three stoppages for their five, and nothing found reverses it.

bigFourFive2020.quote: La Liga has it, so does the Bundesliga, Serie A and France's Ligue1.
teams in LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga and Ligue 1 (as well as all UEFA competitions) have continued with five subs

partial.why: Round 1331 could not two source these leagues' rule for 2026-27 in the time it had, so they keep three changes with no stoppage limit, the game's behaviour before this round, and the help says so. Adding one is a row here with two sources plus the same league in the module's table.

notCovered: A nation's matches (the international jobs) keep three. Cups and continental ties follow the career league's row. Seasons are ruled by their start year, so the 2019-20 restart plays three.
